text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once again, it's time for the summer camp. Like the self-proclaimed outlaw she is, Vodka passes the bus on motorcycle and arrives at camp before everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I catch on to a ruse though, and find out that she's hitched a ride on her dad's bike to look cool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So begins yet another summer camp for this show-off!
